message.text: The frontend auth interceptor lives in `web/src/connect.ts` as `authInterceptor`. It manages two tokens: an access token sent as a Bearer header via in-memory `auth-state`, and a refresh token stored as an HttpOnly cookie with `credentials: include`. The backend package that validates these tokens is `server/auth` (specifically its `Authenticator` class).

The auth interceptor lives in `web/src/connect.ts` as `authInterceptor`. It manages two tokens: a Bearer JWT access token stored in localStorage via `auth-state`, and an HttpOnly refresh token sent via `credentials: include`.

The backend package that validates these tokens is `server/auth`.

q29.
web/src/connect.ts; access token (Bearer JWT) and refresh token (HttpOnly cookie); server/auth

`authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts` attaches `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (from `web/src/auth-state.ts`) and uses `credentials: "include"` so the `memos_refresh` cookie is sent. On 401 it calls `AuthService.RefreshToken` and retries. The backend validates those tokens in `server/auth` (`Authenticator.AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2` / `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`); that package also accepts PATs, which the frontend interceptor does not issue.
